member.name: M:ExtensionApi.Controllers.AiController.OrderPhotos(ExtensionApi.Models.PhotoOrderRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Ranks listing photos and chooses a non-bathroom cover when a suitable alternative exists.
member.remarks: Accepts 2–20 public HTTPS image URLs. Images are analyzed but are not persisted. The response contains every source index exactly once. Clients should retain their original order if this endpoint fails.

member.name: M:ExtensionApi.Controllers.AiController.CheckStreet(ExtensionApi.Models.StreetCheckRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Chooses a street only from the supplied MyHome or SS.ge catalog candidates.
member.remarks: This is a fallback for unresolved or ambiguous catalog matches. It never returns an invented label: selectedLabel is copied server-side from the submitted candidate list. Confidence below 80 returns no match.
